darwin-aarch64.notes:
WorkTwill 1.3.2 for macOS Apple Silicon

Fixes incomplete application signatures that could make a downloaded Mac app appear damaged. The complete app and packaged update now pass strict signature checks, and third-party license texts are included in the bundle. This release also includes the snapshot lock-contention fix.

Apple Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. On first launch, macOS may require System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway. Installation and live in-app upgrade are verified separately. Windows is not updated by this release.

修复 Mac 下载后可能提示“已损坏”的应用签名问题，完整应用与更新归档均检查签名，并随包提供第三方许可。包含快照锁竞争修复。

仅发布 macOS Apple 芯片版，Windows 版本不变。未做 Apple Developer ID 签名与公证；首次打开可能需要在“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性”选择“仍要打开”。安装与线上应用内升级分别验收。
